def update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id: str, passengers: list):
    """
    Update the passenger information of a reservation.

    You MUST submit the COMPLETE passenger list. A reservation's number of passengers can
    NEVER change (policy forbids adding or removing passengers). To edit ONE passenger you
    still resubmit EVERY passenger currently on the reservation, changing only the field(s)
    the user asked for. Each passenger object needs all three fields: first_name, last_name,
    and dob (date of birth, format 'YYYY-MM-DD', e.g. '1992-11-12').

    Worked example — the reservation has 2 passengers [Anya Garcia (dob 1992-11-12),
    Mei Lee (dob 1989-12-13)] and the user wants to rename 'Mei Lee' to 'Mei Garcia'.
    Resubmit BOTH passengers, editing only Mei's last name:
        passengers=[
            {"first_name": "Anya", "last_name": "Garcia", "dob": "1992-11-12"},
            {"first_name": "Mei",  "last_name": "Garcia", "dob": "1989-12-13"}
        ]

    Args:
        reservation_id: The reservation ID, such as 'ZFA04Y'.
        passengers: An array of ALL passenger objects on the reservation (same count as the
            reservation already has), each with first_name, last_name and dob. If you submit
            fewer passengers than the reservation currently has (a partial edit), each
            submitted passenger is matched to an existing one by first name and applied as an
            override onto the full current roster, so unlisted passengers are kept unchanged
            and the passenger count is preserved.

    Returns:
        The updated reservation.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If the reservation is not found.
        ValueError: If the number of passengers does not match.
    """
    def _key(v):
        return str(v if v is not None else "").strip().lower()

    def _match_index(sp, roster, used):
        # exact first+last match first, then a UNIQUE first-name-only match
        fn, ln = _key(sp.get("first_name")), _key(sp.get("last_name"))
        for i, rp in enumerate(roster):
            if i in used:
                continue
            if _key(rp.get("first_name")) == fn and _key(rp.get("last_name")) == ln:
                return i
        cands = [i for i, rp in enumerate(roster)
                 if i not in used and _key(rp.get("first_name")) == fn]
        return cands[0] if len(cands) == 1 else None

    # Repair the common weak-reader mistakes of (a) sending only the changed passenger(s)
    # instead of the whole roster and (b) dropping a passenger's dob. Reconstruct the FULL
    # roster from current state and apply the submitted passengers as field-level overrides.
    # Fires only when the submitted list fits onto the current roster (<= current count) and
    # every submitted passenger maps unambiguously to an existing one; otherwise the input is
    # forwarded unchanged so a correct full list always passes through untouched.
    if isinstance(passengers, list) and passengers and all(isinstance(p, dict) for p in passengers):
        current = env_get_reservation_details(reservation_id=reservation_id)
        if isinstance(current, dict) and isinstance(current.get("passengers"), list):
            roster = [dict(p) for p in current["passengers"]]
            if 0 < len(passengers) <= len(roster):
                repaired = [dict(p) for p in roster]
                used = set()
                ok = True
                for sp in passengers:
                    idx = _match_index(sp, roster, used)
                    if idx is None:
                        ok = False
                        break
                    used.add(idx)
                    merged = dict(roster[idx])
                    for k, v in sp.items():
                        if v is not None and v != "":
                            merged[k] = v
                    repaired[idx] = merged
                if ok:
                    passengers = repaired

    return env_update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id=reservation_id, passengers=passengers)
